verdict.rationale: Okta's SSO docs confirm the core value prop of one login granting access to multiple assigned apps, and a community comment corroborates that Okta ships a Chrome browser extension in practice ('Chrome plugin is OKish'). However, the evidence pack lacks first-party documentation of the actual end-user dashboard/app-launcher UI itself (tile catalog, assignment-based visibility) — missing for 10: official docs describing the End-User Dashboard/My Applications page, browser extension feature documentation, and independent hands-on review of the launcher UX beyond one brief mention.
